fib: ______ is the phenomenon on which the electrical resistivity of metals or alloys drop to zero (infinite conductivity) when cooled into its critical temperature.
Superconductivity
Superconductivity is the phenomenon on which the electrical resistivity of metals or alloys drop to zero (infinite conductivity) when cooled into its critical temperature.
______ is the simplest way to represent the electronic structure of metals.
free electron model
A free electron model is the simplest way to represent the electronic structure of metals.
______ is the energy distribution of particles that obey the Pauli Exclusion Principle.
Fermi energy surface
Fermi energy surface is the energy distribution of particles that obey the Pauli Exclusion Principle.
